summary: A hiker slid ~50 yards downhill when the trail gave way on the Snowmass Creek Trail (Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness) ~11:48 AM; injured and unable to move. 12 MRA members responded, made contact 1:11 PM; hiker transported to Aspen Valley Hospital 2:36 PM.
location: Snowmass Creek Trail, Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
notes: MRA FB mission post (posted 2023-06-10; Pitkin SO case 23P005587). Org-post source per user rule 2026-09-17; permalink opened live by browser task. 2026-09-18: merged additional MRA FB post (Snowmass Creek Trail slide).
